result.summary: 84-year-old man after fall-related hip fracture fixation on 6/27, with intracerebral hemorrhage/encephalopathy and pre-existing stroke-related hemiplegia, aphasia, and cognitive deficits; fall precautions and mobility assistance are supported. Latest findings include recurrent renal dysfunction (creatinine 2.0), lactate 4.0 mmol/L, and hypoxemia, warranting clinical reassessment of monitoring needs; he is explicitly documented as not intubated. No contact-isolation indication or active drips, vascular lines, or tubes are documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No supporting organism or explicit precaution: MRSA screen negative and urine culture showed mixed flora consistent with contamination.
